deterministic.name: check-verifier-contract.py
deterministic.evidence: Manual contract review plus verified reused/raw controls: fresh bash -n passes; test.sh:60-61 prewrites zero and traps cleanup, :104-111 launches sanitized/unprivileged, :193 exports the helper, and :212-227 has staged order. However cleanup at :33-39 sends only TERM then unbounded wait before ensure_reward. qc/proposals/coldwater-shared-harness/evidence/results.json original cleanup control timed out after 10.012s, required exit -9, and left the child alive. Original restart control term_ignored exited 0 after 5.707s with old_alive=true and the old volatile marker; original-term_ignored/app-restart.log shows new process EADDRINUSE followed by ready=1. Original scored_timeout/scored_error tails retain graded=1/no_op=0 despite no completed scored evaluation, contrary to the documented plain-zero failure contract. Reuse is valid because original source SHA256 bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa exactly equals the frozen test.sh; all cited raw-index hashes were independently verified. These are extracted synthetic control runs, not a full configured judge. Current launcher-timeout-control also demonstrates urlopen(timeout=2).read() taking 3.519s through a trickled body, so that socket timeout is not a total readiness deadline.
deterministic.counterexample: A server retaining its library only in memory and ignoring SIGTERM keeps serving after the helper starts a replacement that fails EADDRINUSE. The helper reports success, so the restart readback can credit persistence without a process replacement. A conforming app with a long or resistant shutdown handler can make final cleanup hang and lose normal verifier completion; an otherwise correct app whose scored judge times out receives a completed-looking zero record from the preceding gates-only scoring pass.
deterministic.suggested_fix: Have the shared-harness owner supply an approved canonical repair with bounded TERM/KILL process-group cleanup, verified old-group termination and new-PID readiness, a total readiness deadline, and explicit plain-zero evaluator-failure records; bind and rerun those controls and a full configured verifier on the repaired candidate without locally altering shared policy.
